# Draft:Edwardaganesh

Edward Anim (born 29th March 1998) known in the media space as Edwardaganesh, is a Ghanaian media personality and an Actor from Konongo, Ghana. He gained recognition following his positive comments on Davido’s strategic album planning emphasizing that “Artists Need To Take Their Media Promotions Serious” whilst on air with Media Personality, Prudent of Guide Radio. He added saying “Davido was really strategic with his Timeless album promotion.” Edwardaganesh made another remark saying “Ghanaian Artistes Need to Blend Our Local Language with English to Go Global like Angelique Kidjo and others.”
Early life and education
Edwardaganesh attended secondary education at Akyem Akroso, where he discovered his passion for acting and participated in various drama activities, which fueled his desire to pursue a career in the acting field. He made his acting debut with the movie “The Struggle of A Girl Child” which featured popular actors like Kofi Adjorlolo and since then, have featured in several other productions.
Career
Edwardaganesh holds a Diploma in Nursing Certificate from 37 Military Hospital Nursing and Midwifery Training College and currently pursuing a two-year Bachelor of Science in Nursing at the University of Ghana.
Personal life
Edwardaganesh is not married and has no children.
